REPORT
Date April 14 1933

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. No. D 4756 Date 15/4/33）

Subject (in full) Communist handbills bearing on the Anniversary of General
Chiang Kai-shek's Anti-Communist Campaign - April 12, 1927.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名]

I forward herewith together with summarized translation
of two specimen copies of communist handbills bearing on the
above anniversary which were found by the Municipal Police at
the corners of Nanking-Kwangse and Nanking-Kweichow Roads
apparently thrown from the Building of the Sun Sun Departmental
Store, Nanking Road, during the evening of April 12 :-

(1) Handbill entitled "Manifesto issued by the Shanghai Labour
Federation(Old Labour Union) to recruit new members on the
occasion of the 'April 12 Anniversary'," dated 12.4.33,
exhorting workers in Shanghai to unite and join the Shanghai
Labour Federation, and to oppose the attack of the
imperialists as well as Kuomintang capitalists on labourers.

(2) Handbill containing slogans, purporting to have emanated
from the Shanghai Labour Federation (Old Labour Union)
urging local workers to declare a general strike and to
hold demonstrations on April 12, to revive the Shanghai
Labour Federation, to oppose the 'White Terror' and to demand
improved working conditions.

yrs

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 涉及蒋介石将军反共运动纪念日——1927年4月12日的共产党传单。

制作人：侦探督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)。转发人 [签名]

现随函附上两份在上海公共租界警方于南京路与广西路、南京路与贵州路路口发现的、据信是在4月12日晚间从南京路新新百货公司大楼抛下的、涉及上述纪念日的共产党传单样本的摘要译文：

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4756
Date 13 / 4 / 33
April

Political (2)

At 10.30 a.m. April 9, the Municipal Police, at
the request of the Chinese Authorities, arrested a
communist suspect named Liu Ping-wan (廖平凡) on
Boone Road. A search of his home, at 203 Boone Road,
unearthed a large quantity of communist literature.
In consequence of this arrest, raids were carried out on
certain other addresses, two further arrests were made
and where further communist circulars seized. The
three accused upon appearing before the Second Branch
of the Kiangsu High Court on April 12 were extradited
to the Chinese Authorities.

At 4 p.m. April 10, the Chapei Police raided 153 Jiu
Kong Lee (虬江里), off Maxwell Road, O.S.L., and arrested
a communist suspect named Wu Te Yun (符德云) and
seized a quantity of communistic literature.

Anniversary of the Anti-Communist Campaign Started by
General Chiang Kai-shek

Under the auspices of the local Kuomintang, a meeting
in commemoration of the above mentioned anniversary was
held in the Local Kuomintang Headquarters, West Gate,
between 10.30 and 11.30 a.m. April 12, when some 50
persons claiming to represent local public bodies attended.
Speeches appropriate to the occasion were made.

A similar meeting was held in the 5th District Kuomin-
tang Branch, 215 Police Station Road, Pestung, on the
same forenoon, some 40 persons mostly Kuomintang members
being present.

政治 (2)

4月9日上午10时30分，应中国当局请求，公共租界警方在博恩路逮捕了一名名为廖平凡 (Liu Ping-wan) 的共产党嫌疑犯。对其位于博恩路203号的住所进行搜查后，发现了大量共产党文献。鉴于此次逮捕，警方对其他几处地址进行了突击搜查，又逮捕了两人，并缴获了更多共产党通告。这三名被告于4月12日出庭江苏高等法院第二分院时，被引渡给中国当局。

4月10日下午4时，闸北警方突袭了麦克斯韦尔路（余姚路）外的虬江里153号，逮捕了一名名为符德云 (Wu Te Yun) 的共产党嫌疑犯，并缴获了一批共产党文献。

蒋介石将军发起的反共运动纪念日

在当地国民党的主持下，一场纪念上述纪念日的会议于4月12日上午10时30分至11时30分之间在西门本地国民党总部举行，约有50名声称代表当地公共团体的人士出席。会上发表了符合场合的演讲。

同日上午，在贝当路警察署路215号的第五区国民党分部也举行了类似的会议，约有40人出席，大多为国民党成员。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4756
Date 12 / 4 / 33

April 12, 1933.    Morning Translation.

COMMUNISM

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

ANNIVERSARY OF KUOMINTANG PURIFICATION MOVEMENT.

10 H 756
To-day being the 6th Anniversary of the Kuomintang
Purification Movement, local official organs, public bodies
and schools will hold a general meeting at 10 a.m. in the
hall of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang, Ling Ying
Road, West Gate, to commemorate the occasion.
Yesterday the local Tangpu issued a circular
notice calling on the public to participate in the
commemoration meeting.
The following slogans will be shouted:-
1) Consolidate sincerely to deal with foreign aggressions.
2) Exterminate all reactionary elements.
3) Exert every effort in the bandit-suppression campaign.
4) Work for the completion of district self-government.
5) Overthrow the Japanese Imperialists.
6) Observe the will of Dr. Sun Yat Sen.
7) Long live the Three Principles of the People.
8) Long live the Chinese Kuomintang.
9) Long live the Republic of China.

The Public Safety Bureau and the Settlement
Police have received a secret report to the effect that
Communist elements are planning to incite unemployed workers
to hold demonstrations and processions to-day and that the
radicals will create disturbances at the various passes
leading from Chinese controlled territory to the foreign
Settlements.
As a precautionary measures, the Chinese and the
Settlement authorities will declare martial law from 8 a.m.
to-day until midnight. Double point duty policemen will
be detailed in Nantao and Chapei and Chinese detectives
will be assigned to busy sectors on search party duty.
Armed members of the Peace Preservation Corps will patrol
the streets. Chinese and foreign detectives and policemen
of the Settlement authorities will also be detailed for
duty. All the iron gates on roads leading from Chinese
controlled territory to the foreign Settlements will be closed.
Red Emergency Vans will be active on the streets.
In order to prevent Communists from mingling with
labour bodies, the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang has
ordered all labour unions not to hold meetings to-day.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKERS OF THE NIEN YUEN RUBBER FACTORY.
At 9 a.m. yesterday, the Social Bureau held an
informal meeting at which representatives of the workers
and the proprietor of the Factory were present.

共产主义

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

国民党清党运动纪念日。

10 H 756
今天是国民党清党运动六周年纪念日，本地官方机构、公共团体和学校将于上午10时在西门灵隐路上海特别区国民党部大厅举行全体会议，以纪念这一时刻。
昨天，本地党部发布通函，号召公众参加纪念大会。
将高呼以下口号：
1) 精诚团结以对付外来侵略。
2) 肃清一切反动分子。
3) 全力进行剿匪运动。
4) 致力于完成地方自治。
5) 打倒日本帝国主义者。
6) 遵循孙中山博士遗志。
7) 三民主义万岁。
8) 中国国民党万岁。
9) 中华民国万岁。

公安局和租界警方收到一份秘密报告，称共产党分子正计划煽动失业工人今天举行示威和游行，激进分子将在通往外国租界的各通道制造骚乱。
作为预防措施，中方和租界当局将从今天上午8时至午夜宣布戒严。南市和闸北将增派双岗警员，中国侦探将被派往繁忙地段执行搜捕任务。保安队武装队员将在街头巡逻。租界当局的中外侦探和警察也将被指派执勤。所有连接中方管辖区域与外国租界的道路上的铁门将关闭。红色紧急救护车将在街上待命。
为防止共产党混入劳工团体，上海特别区国民党已命令所有工会今天不得举行会议。

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

年丰橡胶厂罢工者。
昨天上午9时，社会局举行了一次非正式会议，工人代表和厂主出席。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. B. REGISTRY
No. 4756
Date 12 / 4 / 33

Translation of official despatch No: 39 from
Wen Hung-en, Chief of the Public Safety Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, to Major Gerrard,
Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police, dated
April 11, 1933.

According to a confidential report received,
local labourers in the employ of Japanese cotton mills in
the Eastern and Western Districts of Shanghai will hold
demonstrations on April 12, a labour anniversary day.
They will hold meetings and distribute circulars.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Communists
will attempt to instigate an "April 12" Strike, hold
demonstrations, inaugurate the Labourers' Picketing Groups
and commemorate the martyrs.

Apart from ordering my subordinates to adopt
precautionary measures, I send you this despatch with a
request that you will direct your subordinates to act
likewise.

(Seal) Wen Hung-en.

Reg.
Please prepare reply
for signature of
Commissioner of Police
JMG

大上海市政府公安局长文鸿恩 (Wen Hung-en) 于1933年4月11日致上海公共租界工部局警务处处长杰拉德 (Major Gerrard) 的第39号公函译文。

据收到的机密报告，受雇于上海东西两区日本棉纱厂的当地工人将于4月12日（一个劳工纪念日）举行示威。他们将举行会议并分发传单。

共产党将利用这一机会，试图煽动“四一二”罢工，举行示威，成立工人纠察队，并纪念烈士。

除命令我的下属采取预防措施外，特发此函，请阁下指示您的下属采取同样行动。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Anniversary of General Chiang Kai-shek's Anti-Communist
Campaign, April 12, 1927.

Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

According to information secured by Agents
A-4263 and 4382, no definite instructions have been issued
by either the Provincial or the District Committees to
the local subordinate branches of the Chinese Communist
Party regarding the commemoration of the Anniversary of
General Chiang Kai-shek's Anti-Communist Campaign, which
falls on April 12.
It is, however, anticipated that handbills
bearing on the occasion may be surreptitiously disseminated
in the vicinity of industrial concerns in the Eastern
and Western Districts sometime during the day.
